ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on distal regions and 65% low-intensity black pixels across the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs located on the outer distal thirds of both lobes, characterized by dense, low-intensity stippling. The central region surrounding the notch is a solid low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with significant amplitude variations; multiple deep, irregular notches (peaks and valleys) distributed across the horizontal boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge segments, interrupted by significant topographical irregularities, leading to rounded but jagged lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible circular, high-contrast clusters (barnacle colonies) densely packed on the far lateral edges and tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on lateral tips and significant irregular tissue loss/erosion along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique salt-and-pepper pixel distribution within the white pigmented areas, creating a high-frequency mottled texture.
